package clientmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/clientmembers/gen/http/members/client"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	roleDoer struct {
		next  loomhttp.Doer
		path  string
		calls int
	}
)

func TestClientRoles(t *testing.T) {
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var value string
		if err := json.UnmarshalRead(r.Body, &value); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if err := json.MarshalWrite(w, r.URL.Path+":"+value); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	u, err := url.Parse(peer.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		endpoint loom.Endpoint
		builder  func(context.Context, any) (*http.Request, error)
		target   *loomhttp.Doer
	}{
		{"restoreResponseBody", c.ReadOperations.RestoreResponseBodyEndpoint(), c.BuildRestoreResponseBodyRequest, &c.RestoreResponseBodyDoer},
		{"restoreResponseBodyEndpoint", c.ReadOperations.RestoreResponseBodyEndpointEndpoint(), c.BuildRestoreResponseBodyEndpointRequest, &c.RestoreResponseBodyEndpointDoer},
		{"read", c.Read(), c.ReadOperations.BuildReadRequestRequest, &c.ReadDoerDoer2},
		{"readDoer", c.ReadDoer(), c.BuildReadDoerRequest, &c.ReadDoerDoerDoer},
		{"buildReadRequest", c.BuildReadRequest(), c.BuildBuildReadRequestRequest, &c.BuildReadRequestDoer},
		{"readDoerDoer", c.ReadDoerDoer(), c.BuildReadDoerDoerRequest, &c.ReadDoerDoerDoerDoer},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			path := "/read/" + test.name
			doer := &roleDoer{next: peer.Client(), path: path}
			*test.target = doer
			request, err := test.builder(context.Background(), "payload")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if request.URL.Path != path {
				t.Errorf("builder path %q", request.URL.Path)
			}
			result, err := test.endpoint(context.Background(), "payload")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if result != path+":payload" || doer.calls != 1 {
				t.Errorf("result %v calls %d", result, doer.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func (d *roleDoer) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	d.calls++
	if r.URL.Path != d.path {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("wrong role path %q, want %q", r.URL.Path, d.path)
	}
	return d.next.Do(r)
}
